evals.prompt:
/enhance_presentation

Outcome: Sales pitches to new clients

Slide 1: Title Slide
Bishop AI — Intelligent Automation for Modern Teams

Slide 2: The Problem
Companies waste time on repetitive tasks
Employees spend 40% of their day on manual processes
Existing tools don't integrate well
High cost of custom development

Slide 3: Our Solution
Bishop AI automates your workflows
Connects to 100+ tools
No-code setup
ROI in 30 days

Slide 4: How It Works
Step 1: Connect your tools
Step 2: Define your workflow
Step 3: Let Bishop AI run it
Monitor results in real time

Slide 5: Pricing
Starter: $99/month (up to 5 users)
Growth: $299/month (up to 20 users)
Enterprise: Custom pricing
30-day free trial available
evals.expected_output: Structured Markdown report with High-Level Presentation Feedback and slide-by-slide Visual + Copywriting suggestions tailored to sales outcome. Headlines rewritten to be benefit-first, visual suggestions tied to data or persuasion, brand colors referenced.

assertions.name: has-high-level-feedback-section
assertions.description: Output contains a 'High-Level Presentation Feedback' section

assertions.name: has-slide-by-slide-section
assertions.description: Output contains a 'Slide-by-Slide Suggestions' section

assertions.name: covers-all-5-slides
assertions.description: Output addresses all 5 slides from the input

assertions.name: has-visual-and-copy-subsections
assertions.description: Each slide section contains both 'Visual Improvement Ideas' and 'Copywriting Enhancement Recommendations' subsections

assertions.name: references-brand-colors
assertions.description: Output mentions at least one of the brand colors (#0A4C84 or #5E97D1) in visual suggestions

assertions.name: sales-outcome-language
assertions.description: Copywriting suggestions use benefit-first, persuasive language appropriate for a sales outcome (not generic)

assertions.name: no-banned-visual-suggestions
assertions.description: Output does NOT suggest memes, GIFs, or clip art

assertions.name: no-assumed-outcome-note
assertions.description: Output does NOT include an 'Assumed Outcome' disclaimer (since outcome was explicitly provided)

evals.prompt:
/enhance_presentation

Outcome: Training sessions for my team

Slide 1: Introduction to Prompt Engineering
What is a prompt?
Why does prompt quality matter?
Objectives for today's session

Slide 2: Anatomy of a Good Prompt
Role: Tell the AI who it is
Context: Give relevant background
Task: Specify exactly what you want
Format: Define the output structure
Constraints: Set limits (length, tone, etc.)

Slide 3: Common Mistakes
Being too vague
Overloading with instructions
Forgetting to specify format
Not iterating on the prompt

Slide 4: Live Exercise
Prompt 1: Write a cold email for a SaaS product
Improve it using the RCTFC framework
Share results with the group

Slide 5: Key Takeaways
Prompts are instructions, not searches
Clarity beats brevity
Iterate and test
Context is everything
evals.expected_output: Structured Markdown report tailored to training outcome. Visual suggestions include diagrams/frameworks for RCTFC anatomy. Copy suggestions make bullets more memorable and pedagogically engaging. Suggestions simplify jargon.
